entry: 2989-11-10 | Ori | We drove the orcs from the East-gate and took the first hall.
2989-11-12 | Ori | Balin set up his seat in the Chamber of Mazarbul. He is lord of Moria now.
2990-03-15 | Ori | We found true-silver in the deep lodes. Óin went to look for the upper armouries.
2994-11-10 | Ori | Balin was killed by an orc archer in Dimrill Dale while he looked into Mirrormere.
2994-11-14 | Ori | Orcs took the bridge and the second hall. We lost Frár, Lóni and Náli.
2994-12-01 | Ori | The Watcher took Óin near the West-gate. The pool blocks our way out.
2994-12-10 | Ori | The orc drums have not stopped for three days. We have barred the doors of this chamber.
